title: Product Designer (UX/UI, Consumer Web Focus)
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.

title: System Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities:

  • Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.
  • Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server
  • Upgrading ESXi
  • Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring
  • Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs
  • Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions
  • Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable
  • Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis
  • Basic Linux administration
  • On-call support


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)
  • - Server Hardware Management
  • - Virtualization, especially VMware
  • - Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP
  • - Security, including best practices, patch management, vulnerability assessments
  • - Monitoring and Troubleshooting


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions


Before applying for the above position, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here: By responding to the vacancy, you acknowledge that you have read our Privacy notice.*

Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later

title: Analista de empréstimo
description:
About Monee

At Monee, we believe that every team member is essential to our success — and that diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to driving our business and advancing our purpose of changing the world for the better.

Being part of our team means growing within a fast-paced and agile culture. If you love taking on big responsibilities and doing what has never been done before, Monee is the place for you.

Here, you’ll face meaningful challenges, collaborate with a diverse team, and help shape the future of the fintech industry in Brazil — creating a positive impact in the lives of millions.

Work Model

We adopt a hybrid work model, this model allows people to adjust their work environment according to their personal needs, while promoting collaboration and interaction in the office.



What will be your mission?

Planning and execution of projects related to credit products, including participation in and development of initiatives focused on identifying business opportunities, conducting in-depth analyses, and implementing new solutions. Creation of strategic initiatives aimed at driving growth and cost reduction. Leadership of workstreams within high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring concrete and tangible deliverables. Ongoing interaction with teams across different areas and countries, as well as direct collaboration with multiple internal stakeholders and external partners.


What will your day-to-day be like?

  • Build and launch new credit products (with focus on consumer) while monitoring the results of current product portfolio;
  • Identify business opportunities, conduct in-depth analysis, and implement new solutions;
  • Prepare and present business cases to both local and international audiences
  • Own and deliver strategic and tactical initiatives to drive growth and cost reduction;
  • Lead workstreams in high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, with concrete and tangible deliverables;
  • Interact with teams from different areas and countries. Work closely with the SG SeaMoney team.
  • High exposure to top management.



What you need to take on the challenge:

  • Experience in Credit Products for Consumers (BNPL, Personal Loan, Secured Credit etc.)
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, and writing is mandatory);
  • Hands-on profile, ability to think strategically;
  • Data-drive profile, being capable of dealing with complex models and analysis;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional teams and external

stakeholders;

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Benefits:
  • Medical and dental care, extended to dependents;
  • Partnership with Gympass and TotalPass;
  • Flexible meal/food vouchers;
  • Transportation vouchers, mobility vouchers or on-site parking;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Zenklub;
  • Discretionary annual bonus, linked to performance.

COME MAKE HISTORY WITH US.

WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE, MAKES US BETTER!

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Vendedor(a) - Outlet
description:
Quem somos?

A Breton construiu uma história sólida e se tornou referência no mercado de mobiliário de alto padrão. A trajetória da empresa é marcada pela sofisticação, design diferenciado e compromisso com a responsabilidade ambiental e social, sendo reconhecida como uma das principais referências do segmento no Brasil.

Pautada pelos valores de família e conduzida por uma família, a marca tem expertise na criação, desenvolvimento e produção de mobiliário com alto valor agregado, que passa por uma curadoria afiada de uma equipe multidisciplinar preparada para atender as mais diversas demandas de um mercado exigente e que se moderniza a todo momento.

A Breton assume sua responsabilidade com a sustentabilidade e está comprometida em adotar práticas em todas as etapas de sua cadeia produtiva, buscando um melhor aproveitamento dos recursos naturais. Uma das conquistas da marca é o selo Carbono Negativo, obtido pela primeira vez, em 2022. Nos anos de 2020 e 2021 a Breton já era reconhecida como Carbono Neutro, ou seja, compensou todas as suas emissões.

title: SiteCore Developer
description:
We are looking for a Sitecore Developer Developer for a 100% Remote, 5 month +, 1099 contract


Location: Brazil or Colombia, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Sitecore Developer to design, develop, and support enterprise-level CMS and commerce platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Sitecore 8 and 9.x , C# , and the .NET Framework , with a proven ability to build scalable, high-performance solutions in complex enterprise environments.

This role involves working on both modernization initiatives and ongoing support of legacy Sitecore implementations while ensuring code quality, scalability, and system reliability.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop Sitecore MVC solutions for enterprise CMS and commerce platforms
  • Build and maintain custom Sitecore APIs and integrations
  • Support and modernize legacy Sitecore environments
  • Ensure application performance, scalability, and code quality best practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust digital solutions
  • Contribute to Sitecore version upgrades and platform migrations


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Extensive experience developing Sitecore MVC solutions in enterprise environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Sitecore 8 and Sitecore 9.3
  • Experience with Sitecore Commerce (add-on)
  • Proficiency in C# and .NET Framework
  • Experience working with Sitecore APIs
  • Experience developing or supporting Azure web services (JavaScript-based)
  • Proven experience maintaining and upgrading legacy Sitecore platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience migrating between Sitecore versions
  • Experience with Node.js migrations
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments and deployment best practices
  • SiteCore Certifications

title: System Architect (Design System)
description:
Client Summary – Client Corporation

Client Corporation is a global power management leader with a commitment to innovation, reliability, and sustainability. With operations in more than 175 countries, Client designs technologies that improve efficiency, safety, and performance across industrial, electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical systems. As Client expands its digital ecosystem, the company is investing heavily in enterprise architecture, design systems, cloud modernization, and scalable platforms. This role sits at the core of Client’s digital experience strategy and helps shape the future of UI frameworks, enterprise applications, and design consistency across global teams.


Job Description – System Architect (Design System)

Client: Client Corporation

Position: System Architect – Design System

Location: Remote / Hybrid (per Client requirements)


Position Overview

Client’s IT organization is seeking an experienced System Architect – Design System to lead the architecture, design, and end‑to‑end implementation of enterprise‑scale design system solutions. This architect will translate business needs into scalable technical architectures, enforce enterprise standards, and guide development teams through solution execution. As a senior technical leader, this role drives architectural governance, evaluates emerging technologies, and mentors cross‑functional engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Solution Design

  • Architect and validate enterprise‑grade software and design system solutions.
  • Create architecture artifacts, diagrams, reference models, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure solutions meet performance, availability, and security standards.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead engineering teams through complex technical challenges and solution delivery.
  • Provide mentorship, guidance, and architectural oversight to developers and technical leads.
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and integration planning.

Requirements Translation

  • Translate business and UX requirements into well‑defined technical designs.
  • Define system interactions, data flows, integration points, and component‑level architecture.

Governance & Standards

  • Enforce adherence to Client’s enterprise architecture standards and development guidelines.
  • Participate in architecture governance forums and lead solution approval processes.

Future‑State & Scalability Planning

  • Develop future‑state architecture strategies that ensure scalability, performance, and compliance.
  • Recommend improvements that reduce technical debt and increase architectural maturity.

Implementation Oversight

  • Oversee development lifecycle activities to ensure high‑quality, consistent implementation.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across front‑end, back‑end, and integration layers.

Strategic Contribution

  • Influence and contribute to Client’s technology roadmap and long‑term digital strategy.
  • Drive innovation and promote adoption of modern frameworks, tools, and best practices.


Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, and solution design.
  • Extensive experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.5) including component development and system integration.
  • 6–7 years of front‑end experience with Angular (19+ preferred), NgRx, and modern UI frameworks (Tailwind, Angular Material, PrimeNG).
  • 10+ years of back‑end experience with Java, .NET, Spring Boot, REST services, and database technologies.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, microservices, cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), and security frameworks.
  • Hands‑on experience with DevOps tools including Git, Maven, NPM, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Jest, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, system documentation, architecture presentation, and leadership skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience aligning solutions with enterprise roadmaps and long‑term architecture strategies.
  • Background in architectural maturity assessment and technical debt remediation.
  • Demonstrated success in team mentorship, innovation leadership, and technology evangelism.


Why This Role Matters

This architect will define and evolve the technical foundation behind Client’s enterprise design system—ensuring consistency, reusability, and engineering excellence across global applications. The role carries high visibility and has direct influence on Client’s digital modernization initiatives, making it a key strategic position within IT.

Client’s IT organization is seeking an experienced System Architect – Design System to lead the architecture, design, and end‑to‑end implementation of enterprise‑scale design system solutions. This architect will translate business needs into scalable technical architectures, enforce enterprise standards, and guide development teams through solution execution. As a senior technical leader, this role drives architectural governance, evaluates emerging technologies, and mentors cross‑functional engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Solution Design

  • Architect and validate enterprise‑grade software and design system solutions.
  • Create architecture artifacts, diagrams, reference models, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure solutions meet performance, availability, and security standards.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead engineering teams through complex technical challenges and solution delivery.
  • Provide mentorship, guidance, and architectural oversight to developers and technical leads.
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and integration planning.

Requirements Translation

  • Translate business and UX requirements into well‑defined technical designs.
  • Define system interactions, data flows, integration points, and component‑level architecture.

Governance & Standards

  • Enforce adherence to Client’s enterprise architecture standards and development guidelines.
  • Participate in architecture governance forums and lead solution approval processes.

Future‑State & Scalability Planning

  • Develop future‑state architecture strategies that ensure scalability, performance, and compliance.
  • Recommend improvements that reduce technical debt and increase architectural maturity.

Implementation Oversight

  • Oversee development lifecycle activities to ensure high‑quality, consistent implementation.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across front‑end, back‑end, and integration layers.

Strategic Contribution

  • Influence and contribute to Client’s technology roadmap and long‑term digital strategy.
  • Drive innovation and promote adoption of modern frameworks, tools, and best practices.


Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, and solution design.
  • Extensive experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.5) including component development and system integration.
  • 6–7 years of front‑end experience with Angular (19+ preferred), NgRx, and modern UI frameworks (Tailwind, Angular Material, PrimeNG).
  • 10+ years of back‑end experience with Java, .NET, Spring Boot, REST services, and database technologies.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, microservices, cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), and security frameworks.
  • Hands‑on experience with DevOps tools including Git, Maven, NPM, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Jest, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, system documentation, architecture presentation, and leadership skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience aligning solutions with enterprise roadmaps and long‑term architecture strategies.
  • Background in architectural maturity assessment and technical debt remediation.
  • Demonstrated success in team mentorship, innovation leadership, and technology evangelism.


Why This Role Matters

This architect will define and evolve the technical foundation behind Client’s enterprise design system—ensuring consistency, reusability, and engineering excellence across global applications. The role carries high visibility and has direct influence on Client’s digital modernization initiatives, making it a key strategic position within IT.

title: Microsoft Dynamics Developer
description:
About You

You are a technically strong Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Developer who enjoys building, customizing, and integrating enterprise-grade ERP solutions. You thrive in structured environments, value best practices, and take ownership of delivering reliable, well-documented systems. You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and feel comfortable supporting, maintaining, and evolving complex business applications.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Developer Associate (mandatory and up to date, with annual renewal).
  • Strong experience developing and customizing Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) solutions.
  • Solid understanding of D365 F&O architecture, development lifecycle, and best practices.
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining integrations using Azure Data Factory for ETL and data synchronization.
  • Hands-on experience using Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) for deployment, monitoring, environment management, and maintenance.
  • Ability to collaborate with functional and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for production and non-production environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Develop, customize, and maintain Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations applications based on business requirements.
  • Design, build, and support data integrations using Azure Data Factory, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
  • Use Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) to manage deployments, monitor environments, and support application health.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (functional consultants, developers, business users) to deliver high-quality solutions.

title: Banco de Talentos (Java | .NET | Fullstack)
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia que atua no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais para diferentes contextos e desafios de negócio. Estamos em constante crescimento e, por isso, abrimos este Banco de Talentos para profissionais de tecnologia que queiram fazer parte do nosso radar para oportunidades atuais e futuras.


Este não é um processo seletivo para uma vaga única e imediata , mas sim um banco de talentos estratégico. Nosso objetivo é conhecer profissionais que atuam ou desejam atuar em projetos 100% remotos , para que possamos entrar em contato assim que surgirem oportunidades alinhadas ao seu perfil.


Perfis que buscamos com frequência:

  • Desenvolvedores(as) Java (Pleno e Sênior);
  • Desenvolvedores(as) .NET;
  • Desenvolvedores(as) Fullstack;
  • Outros perfis em desenvolvimento de software também são bem-vindos.


O que pode acontecer após sua candidatura?

  • Sua candidatura ficará ativa em nosso banco de talentos;
  • Quando surgirem novas oportunidades, entraremos em contato;
  • Algumas vagas podem ser 100% remotas e outras em modelo híbrido , conforme a necessidade do projeto;
  • Caso uma posição remota seja encerrada, poderemos te convidar para conversar sobre outras oportunidades compatíveis com seu perfil.


O que buscamos em nossos talentos:

  • Boa base técnica na sua stack de atuação;
  • Interesse em atuar em ambientes colaborativos e dinâmicos;
  • Comunicação clara e vontade de evoluir constantemente;
  • Experiência prévia na área será considerada conforme o nível da vaga.


✨ Se você busca visibilidade, novas oportunidades e fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia em expansão, esse banco de talentos é para você.


Candidate-se e venha fazer parte do nosso ecossistema de tecnologia!


Benefícios e Incentivos: Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistências Médica e Odontológica (SulAmérica), Seguro de Vida (Prudential), Previdência Privada (Onze) e acesso ao WellHub para cuidar da mente e do corpo, além de VR Caju.


Desenvolvimento: Coparticipação na assinatura do Alura, ajuda para cursos de inglês, Ciclo de Avaliação de Desempenho com Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), e programas internos de mentoria e capacitação profissional.


Equilíbrio: Com nosso benefício de Antecipação de Férias, quem tem entre 6 e 12 meses de contrato pode aproveitar o descanso sem perder esse direito ao mudar de emprego.


Diversidade e Inclusão: Todas as nossas oportunidades são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência.


Sobre a Elumini Somos uma consultoria sólida no mercado de TI, com operações na América do Sul, América do Norte e Europa. Certificada pelo Great Place to Work®, somos reconhecidos por nossa forma única de valorizar profissionais e promover um ambiente diferenciado.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

title: Data Engineer (Apache NIFI) Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Senior profile (minimum 5 years of professional experience)
  • Very strong data transformation skills , with proven hands-on experience in complex transformation scenarios.
  • Solid knowledge of XML , including advanced usage of XPath for data extraction, manipulation, and validation.
  • At least 2 years of eperience with Apache NIFI.
  • Good understanding of data integration concepts and flow-based programming.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
  • Fluent English
  • Williness to move to Portugal



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hibryd


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Engenheiro de Exchange
description:

title: Senior Business/System Analyst (Disaster Recovery)
description:
Product Overview:

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high-energy, fast-paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for the opportunity of personal growth and success.


Overview

We are seeking a contract Business Analyst to support the development and execution of our Disaster Recovery (DR) Program. This role will help establish structure, documentation, and repeatable processes to ensure our DR efforts are organized, testable, and aligned with business needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.
  • Create and refine documentation such as DR runbooks, process flows, and system recovery procedures.
  • Partner with technical teams to capture system dependencies, failover steps, testing requirements, and validation criteria.
  • Build templates, standards, and repeatable processes to drive consistency across DR documentation.
  • Coordinate project tasks, track progress, and support cross-functional alignment to ensure milestones are met.
  • Facilitate workshops and gather requirements from subject-matter experts.
  • Define DR test planning, evidence capture, post-test reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Ensure documentation aligns with internal standards and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC2).


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Coordinator, or similar role.
  • Experience supporting Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, or technology resilience programs.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical inputs into clear, structured outputs.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, applications, and security teams.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Confluence, Jira, Microsoft 365, and diagramming solutions.
  • Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure, SaaS vendor DR models, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOX, SOC2, or ISO 22301.
  • Prior involvement in DR tabletop exercises


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:
We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached with any request for payment, it is likely fraudulent. Please verify whether the role you are interested in is posted on our official website.



About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Ensino Superior Completo (Cursos de exatas: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm e etc.,);

  • Plano Médico e Plano Odontológico;

  • Ticket Refeição;
  • Veículo;
  • Cartão combustível
  • PPR

Com um amplo portfólio de produtos (mais de 300 apresentações), atua no segmento de OTCs, tarjados e genéricos, presente em mais de 90% das farmácias brasileiras com forte atuação nas categorias de tosse, gastrointestinal, vitaminas, dermatológicos e saúde feminina.

title: Golang Data Engineer
description:
Golang Data Engineer #2613

Position Summary:


Our partner is a quantitative trading organization where live market data, low-latency systems, and proprietary models directly drive capital allocation decisions. As the platform continues to scale, the team is adding a senior engineer to own the real-time streaming ingestion systems that power live trading. You’ll build production-grade Go services that consume live WebSocket feeds, process and time-slice high-throughput market data, and deliver reliable inputs to a C-based trading engine running on AWS. The focus is demanding and meaningful: streaming reliability, automated failover, observability, and production debugging in a latency-sensitive environment where performance and correctness directly impact outcomes. If you enjoy building systems where milliseconds matter and your work influences real capital in motion, this is engineering at its sharpest.


Experience and Education:


  • BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience/field
  • Hands-on experience building production-grade distributed system for real-time or streaming environments
  • Strong production experience developing backend or systems services in Go
  • Experience implementing WebSocket-based live data ingestion
  • Experience deploying and operating services on AWS, specifically EC2 and S3
  • Experience building and deploying containerized services, ideally in Kubernetes environments
  • Experience supporting low-latency, high-availability systems where downtime or delay had direct business impact


Skills and Strengths:


  • Go
  • Real-time streaming systems
  • WebSockets
  • Low-latency architecture
  • Production service development
  • AWS EC2
  • AWS S3
  • Kubernetes
  • Containerization
  • Monitoring
  • Observability
  • Prometheus
  • High-throughput data processing
  • Failover design
  • Distributed systems
  • Debugging live production systems
  • Time-series data handling
  • Data pipeline development
  • Concurrency patterns
  • Systems reliability engineering



Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Rebuild and own the production-grade, real-time market data ingestion system end-to-end
  • Develop high-performance Go services that consume live market data over WebSockets
  • Process and manage high-throughput streaming data across approximately 1,500 equities
  • Aggregate and time-slice streaming data for accurate downstream model consumption
  • Deliver structured, low-latency data feeds to a C-based trading engine running on AWS EC2
  • Design and implement automatic failover from live market feeds to delayed backup streams
  • Ensure data integrity and correctness during feed transitions and recovery scenarios
  • Maintain and validate the historical data ingestion pipeline sourcing from AWS S3
  • Instrument services with monitoring and observability to detect latency spikes, data gaps, and system degradation
  • Debug and resolve live production streaming failures with minimal business disruption
  • Optimize ingestion services for latency, throughput, and fault tolerance
  • Deploy and operate containerized services within cloud-native environments
  • Collaborate directly with technical leadership on architectural decisions and performance tradeoffs
  • Operate independently without daily direction, taking full ownership of reliability and delivery
  • Continuously improve system resilience to support live trading without manual intervention

title: Sr. Desenvolvedor Back-end Java
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

O projeto envolve a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento de uma plataforma robusta, sustentada por uma infraestrutura moderna baseada em APIs. Faremos a integração com um parceiro fintech líder de mercado para lidar com a mecânica central de abertura de contas, financiamento e negociações (trading), permitindo que nossa equipe se concentre em construir uma experiência superior voltada ao cliente.

O sucesso exige mais do que apenas um código excelente. Você se juntará a uma equipe dinâmica e multidisciplinar de gerentes de produto, designers de UX/UI, estrategistas de negócios e especialistas em conformidade (compliance). Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração para navegar por regulamentações financeiras complexas, traduzir requisitos de negócios intrincados em soluções técnicas elegantes e resolver problemas desafiadores de integração com nossos parceiros externos. Esta função é ideal para um solucionador de problemas proativo, que prospera em um ambiente colaborativo e é apaixonado por construir produtos que tenham um impacto real no futuro financeiro das pessoas.


Requisitos

  • Inglês B2 ou superior.
  • Forte proficiência em Java, com foco em frameworks modernos — especialmente Spring Boot.
  • Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados relacionais (ex: Oracle, PostgreSQL) e bancos de dados NoSQL (ex: CosmosDB, DynamoDB).
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços, incluindo padrões de comunicação como REST e gRPC.
  • Expertise em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (event-driven), utilizando ferramentas como RabbitMQ, Kafka e Amazon SQS.
  • Experiência na implantação de aplicações em ambientes de Nuvem (AWS ou Azure).
  • Proficiência em containers e orquestração, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Implementação e automação de pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou ArgoCD.
  • Uso avançado de Git e estratégias colaborativas de ramificação (branching) (Gitflow, práticas de code review).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging, tais como Prometheus, Grafana e ELK Stack.
  • Implementação de estratégias de testes robustas (unitário, integração, ponta a ponta/E2E) utilizando JUnit, Mockito e Testcontainers.
  • Adoção de boas práticas em TDD/BDD e análise de cobertura de código.
  • Experiência de trabalho em equipes Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência prática com sistemas de alto volume e alta escalabilidade.
  • Capacidade comprovada de contribuir para refatoração de código, otimização de desempenho e melhorias arquiteturais contínuas.
  • Compreensão de conceitos de sistemas distribuídos e sua aplicação prática.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de serviços complementares em Node.js.
  • Experiência com plataformas de investimento.
  • Experiência em ambiente financeiro.
  • Certificações em Nuvem (Cloud).


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida.


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Picpay benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Picpay benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);

title: Java Developer with Kotlin (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 4+ years of experience in software development;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java , including microservices architecture using Spring Boot (mandatory);
  • At least 3 years of experience with Kotlin;
  • Fluent English (B2+) is mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (1x on-site).


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Vendas
description:
Descrição da Empresa A AlexandroGonSan é especialista em ambientes de trabalho e há mais de 27 anos ajuda organizações a transformarem seus espaços de atuação. Nosso trabalho é pautado por uma abordagem consultiva, colaborativa e fundamentada em uma vasta experiência e conhecimento técnico. Atuamos com empresas de diferentes portes, de startups a grandes corporações globais. Nossa missão é criar espaços que realmente importam, inspirando as pessoas a serem mais produtivas, engajadas e realizadas nos seus ambientes de trabalho.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um profissional de vendas para integrar nossa equipe e contribuir para o crescimento e desenvolvimento da empresa. As responsabilidades do cargo incluem identificar oportunidades de vendas, construir relacionamentos sólidos com potenciais clientes, apresentar as soluções da AlexandroGonSan e oferecer suporte ao cliente para garantir sua satisfação. Este é um cargo temporário e será desempenhado remotamente, possibilitando flexibilidade geográfica para o candidato ou candidata.

Qualificações

  • Comunicação e Atendimento ao Cliente: É fundamental que a pessoa candidate possua excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, assim como experiência em atender e solucionar as necessidades dos clientes.
  • Vendas e Treinamento: Experiência comprovada em vendas, com habilidade para promover treinamentos e apresentar produtos ou serviços de forma efetiva.
  • Gestão de Vendas: Conhecimento em gerenciamento de vendas, desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais e capacidade de cumprir metas estabelecidas.
  • Adicionalmente, será considerado um diferencial possuir experiência no setor de design de espaços ou construção, além de fluência em outros idiomas.

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno - 3D/XR
description:
A T-Systems, multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom, busca Desenvolvedor Pleno com bom nível de idioma inglês e forte atuação em 3D e XR para criar experiências imersivas em tempo real, utilizando tecnologias de AR, VR e Mixed Reality, em projetos inovadores e de alto impacto visual.

Atuação 100% remota!



O que esperamos de você:

• 3+ anos de experiência com Maya e/ou Blender

• 3+ anos de experiência com Unity e/ou Godot

• Experiência na criação e no orçamento de assets para aplicações XR/VR e renderização 3D em tempo real

• Primeira experiência com otimização de CAD

• Inglês para atuação em ambiente internacional


O que você vai fazer:

• Criar conteúdo 3D e XR imersivo para plataformas de AR, VR e Mixed Reality

• Projetar e desenvolver assets e ambientes interativos, incluindo modelagem, rigging e animação

• Trabalhar com Unity, Maya, Blender e outras ferramentas de 3D em tempo real

• Colaborar com designers, desenvolvedores e storytellers para dar vida a conceitos inovadores

• Prototipar rapidamente e iterar sobre tecnologias emergentes

• Pesquisar tendências, ferramentas e métodos em XR, 3D em tempo real e storytelling imersivo

• Contribuir ativamente para ideação criativa e storytelling visual


Por que se juntar a nós:

• Trabalhar com experiências XR e 3D de última geração

• Atuar em um time criativo, colaborativo e multidisciplinar

• Ter espaço para inovação, experimentação e crescimento técnico

• Evoluir em projetos que combinam tecnologia, arte e narrativa



Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, colaboração e desafios internacionais, essa é a sua chance de acelerar sua carreira!


Candidate-se agora e venha desenvolver o futuro com a gente!

title: Analista de Gestão de Mudança
description:
Cargo: Analista de Gestão de Mudança - Pleno

Modelo: Remoto

Contrato: PJ ou CLT - Alocação

Jornada: seg a sexta em horário comercial


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Pleno de Gestão de Mudança, com perfil dinâmico, proativo e colaborativo,

que traga conceitos e práticas consolidadas de gestão de mudança para apoiar projetos estratégicos da organização.

• Monitorar indicadores de adesão e propor ajustes nas estratégias.

• Experiência prévia em projetos de Gestão de Mudança.

• Conhecimento em metodologias de gestão de mudança.

• Boa habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento com diferentes públicos.

• Perfil proativo, dinâmico e orientado a resultados.

• Desejável experiência em ambientes de transformação digital.

description:
Estrutura Internacional para Profissionais com Carteira ativa de investidores de alta renda | Remuneração em USD | Modelo High Performance


Selecionamos profissionais com carteira ativa que desejam operar sob uma estrutura global, com liquidez diária em USD e modelo de alta performance.


Top performers (com boa carteira ativa) chegam a US$ 1.000+/dia em comissões.


Estamos expandindo nacionalmente um modelo internacional de alta frequência com hedge automático, em parceria com corretora global multirregulada, com 30+ anos de mercado e presença em 40+ países.

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Rotina disciplinada de funil e acompanhamento
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultado


Por que vale a pena:

● Comissões em USD com liquidez diária (PIX/Cripto)

●

title: VMware Administrator (VSphere)
description:
Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities:

  • Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.
  • Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server
  • Upgrading ESXi
  • Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring
  • Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs
  • Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions
  • Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable
  • Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis
  • Basic Linux administration
  • On-call support


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)
  • Server Hardware Management
  • Virtualization, especially VMware
  • Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP
  • Security, including best practices, patch management, vulnerability assessments
  • Monitoring and Troubleshooting


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Managing backups
  • Dell Server Hardware
  • PowerShell
  • Python
  • Storage Platforms such as EMC, Netapp, Isilon, etc.
  • Storage Protocols, including iSCSI, Fibre Channel, NFS
  • Storage Virtualization
  • Storage Security, including access controls and encryption data at rest
  • Ansible


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Representante comercial de vendas
description:
REPRESENTANTE COMERCIAL | DIOXSAN QUÍMICA


Essa vaga não é pra quem quer só \"bater meta e ir embora\".


É pra quem quer dominar um mercado técnico, resolver problemas 

reais de clientes e trabalhar com produtos que entregam resultado 

visível.


SOBRE A DIOXSAN


Há 13 anos atuamos no fornecimento de soluções químicas para tratamento de efluentes industriais. Representamos fabricantes de confiança e oferecemos suporte técnico especializado para aplicação correta dos produtos. Trabalhamos com indústrias que levam conformidade ambiental a sério: alimentícias, químicas, frigoríficos, laticínios, têxteis e concessionárias de saneamento. \"Química objetiva, resultado eficiente\" não é só slogan. É como operamos.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER


→ Prospecção ativa constante: ligações, e-mails, networking

→ Desenvolver e qualificar leads em sua região

→ Realizar visitas técnicas em ETEs industriais

→ Entender processos de tratamento e identificar oportunidades

→ Apresentar soluções técnicas com suporte do nosso time

→ Negociar contratos e acompanhar implementação

→ Manter relacionamento de longo prazo (retenção > aquisição)

→ Trabalhar junto com equipe técnica em testes de campo


Não é home office. É telefone, campo, ETE, chão de fábrica, sala de reunião e mesa de negociação.


O QUE BUSCAMOS


ESSENCIAL:

✓ Experiência em vendas B2B (preferencialmente técnicas)

✓ Facilidade de comunicação com públicos diversos (do operador ao diretor industrial)

✓ Carteira de habilitação categoria B

✓ Disponibilidade para viagens regionais

✓ Ensino médio completo


DIFERENCIAL (não eliminatório):

✓ Formação técnica ou superior em Química, Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas

✓ Experiência prévia com produtos químicos industriais

✓ Conhecimento de processos de tratamento de efluentes

✓ Carteira de clientes na região


NÃO BUSCAMOS:

✗ Quem só quer \"bater meta e ir embora\"

✗ Quem tem nojo de ambientes industriais

✗ Quem não gosta de aprender aspectos técnicos


O QUE OFERECEMOS


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

- Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

- Remuneração variável atrativa baseada em resultados

- Comissões sobre vendas (sem teto)


SUPORTE E DESENVOLVIMENTO:

- Treinamento técnico completo (produtos e aplicações)

- Acompanhamento com time técnico em campo

- Acesso a materiais e casos de aplicação


ESTRUTURA DE TRABALHO:

- Ajuda de custo para deslocamentos

- Amostras e materiais de apresentação

- CRM e ferramentas de gestão


POR QUE DIOXSAN?


Porque aqui você não vai apenas \"vender química\". Você vai:


- Resolver problemas reais de clientes

title: GCP Data Architect | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar a concepção, definição e implementação da plataforma de dados na Google Cloud Platform (GCP);
  • Criar, evoluir e otimizar data warehouses na nuvem utilizando BigQuery;
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e de alta performance;
  • Desenvolver pipelines de processamento de dados em modelos batch e streaming;
  • Orquestrar fluxos de dados e integrações utilizando Apache Airflow;
  • Gerenciar dados estruturados, semiestruturados e não estruturados, assegurando qualidade, segurança e governança;
  • Implementar integrações com APIs e ferramentas de Business Intelligence (BI);
  • Definir boas práticas de modelagem, padronização e governança de dados;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times técnicos e áreas de negócio na definição de soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Garantir eficiência operacional, confiabilidade e escalabilidade da plataforma de dados.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência comprovada em Google Cloud Platform (GCP), com domínio de BigQuery e do ecossistema de dados na nuvem;
  • Experiência em orquestração de dados com Apache Airflow;
  • Proficiência em SQL e Python;
  • Experiência com processamento e análise de grandes volumes de dados utilizando Apache Spark;
  • Conhecimento em consumo e integração de dados via APIs;
  • Vivência com ferramentas e conceitos de Business Intelligence;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados, modelagem e boas práticas de engenharia de dados;
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis de colaboração, utilizando Scrum, Kanban e ferramentas como Azure DevOps.

title: HR and Operations Administrative Support
description:
Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for an HR & Operations Administrative Support (Independent Contractor) . Responsibilities include supporting the employee lifecycle by posting job ads, assisting with hiring processes, preparing and sending contracts, onboarding new agents, managing system access, preparing and reviewing payroll, and supporting workforce performance and attendance tracking.

This role will also assist with performance review coordination, employee relations support, terminations and offboarding processes, and ensuring all system access and tools are properly revoked when contracts end. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while supporting leadership and operations teams.


Qualifications


  • Strong organizational and process management skills
  • Experience supporting HR, recruiting, operations, or administrative functions
  • Experience with onboarding, offboarding, or contract coordination
  • Experience working with remote teams is a plus
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Full Proficiency in English
  • High school diploma or equivalent; HR or administration certifications are advantageous


Requirements =


  • PC or laptop with at least 8GB of RAM
  • At least 200mbps internet speed
  • Headset
  • Dual screen setup
  • At least 3+ years of experience in HR support, recruiting support, administrative, or operations roles
  • Professional English Level


What we will offer you =


  • You will be working as an independent contractor (MEI), providing services between 8am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time
  • You get paid R$ 6k (six thousand brazilian reais monthly)
  • Paid major US holidays


If you believe you are a fit, we highly encourage you to apply now! :)

title: Solutions Architect (Pré-Vendas Estratégico)
description:
Objetivo:

Atuar como elo estratégico entre as áreas comercial e técnica, garantindo que as soluções propostas para contas estratégicas estejam alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio dos clientes, sejam tecnicamente consistentes, aderentes aos requisitos regulatórios e competitivas do ponto de vista comercial. A função contribui diretamente para o crescimento de receita, fortalecimento da confiança do cliente e sucesso das entregas.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Participar de reuniões com a equipe comercial e clientes estratégicos para compreender necessidades e prioridades;
  • Levantar requisitos técnicos e de negócio;
  • Identificar dores, objetivos, restrições e critérios de sucesso do cliente;
  • Propor arquiteturas e tecnologias alinhadas ao ambiente e aos objetivos de negócio do cliente;
